title: Tesla Stock (TSLA) Rises 0.5% to $379.78 (Nov 10)
summary: Tesla (TSLA) rose 0.46% to $379.78 on Nov 10 as the Nasdaq fell 0.74%, with news on the Cybertruck backlog and the San Antonio robotaxi launch.
body_markdown:
## Why Tesla Stock Rose


None of the sources reviewed named a company-specific cause for Tuesday's gain, so the move stands out mainly against a Nasdaq Composite that closed at 25,065.88, down 0.74%. According to[24/7 Wall St.](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/lucid-jumps-8-1-75-165551966.html) , October's[consumer price index](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/after-mondays-rally-us-cpi-tonight/) came in hotter than expected, raising the odds of a Federal Reserve rate hike, and the outlet described Tesla as little changed in early trading.


The session followed Tesla's[robotaxi launch in San Antonio](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/tesla-tsla-stock-news-november-10-2026/) , which began at 5 a.m. local time on November 9, 2026. As reported by[GuruFocus](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/tesla-stocks-move-lower-day-174917522.html) , Tesla did not disclose operating hours, service-area size or fleet size, and the shares traded lower on Tuesday morning before the stock recovered to close higher.


Musk also said in a post on X on Saturday, November 7, that the Cybertruck order backlog is "far more than we can make before dismantling the line," which is expected to come down around June or July 2027 to make room for the Cybercab, per[Benzinga](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/elon-musk-says-teslas-cybertruck-193006712.html) . He said Tesla will add an extra shift to try to fill outstanding orders.


## TSLA Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- Tesla plans to hand the Cybertruck line to the Cybercab, a two-seat robotaxi that Benzinga describes as central to Musk's plan to turn Tesla into an AI and robotics company.
- San Antonio adds to a robotaxi footprint led by Austin, where safety monitors were removed in January 2026 and more than 400 autonomous vehicles are registered, according to GuruFocus.
- The stock closed 1.20 percentage points ahead of the Nasdaq Composite on a day the 10-year Treasury yield rose 10.0 basis points.


### Risks


- Benzinga's analysis counts 8,295 third-quarter deliveries in Tesla's "other models" category, which includes the Cybertruck, a pace it puts at about 13% of Musk's 250,000-unit annual goal at the high end, and investor Ross Gerber called the wind-down "another failure."
- Robotaxi fleets outside Austin remain small, about 24 vehicles in Fort Worth and about five in Miami, and Tesla logged fewer paid-customer miles in Q2 2026 than in Q1, per GuruFocus, which said the next test is whether paid miles rise again in the[fourth-quarter report](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/how-to-read-an-earnings-report/) .
- Angel investor and Tesla shareholder Jason Calacanis predicted that Democrats will "block autonomy" after the midterms, and[TIKR](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/tesla-bull-predicts-democrats-block-170625384.html) noted that a stalled federal bill such as the SELF DRIVE Act is the bigger risk.
